task: CLI analytics: a session reopened later by an idle client is no longer listed or counted for the reopen window, and its duration ends at the last real activity (shared real-work SQL filter applied in the rollup and the reader).

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: PostgresCliAnalyticsReader, rollup refresher (rollups.py), shared vocabulary constants, new real_work_sql filter module

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Changes which rows count as activity in stored session_dims and in reader windows across sessions, overview, users, repositories, cost and activity endpoints; SQL built from vocabulary constants; stored ends of already-rolled-up sessions need recompute; harness-specific event kinds and built-in command names
technical_risk.mitigation: Single shared real-work filter used by both rollup and reader; filter built only from code constants; live-Postgres reopen scenario test (derived and NULL activity facts) plus unit tests for the filter, reader, rollups and vocabulary

key_reasoning.reason: Reader, rollup refresher, shared vocabulary and a new shared real-work SQL module all change together so the stored session end and the reported end agree.
Redefines what counts as session activity in analytics SQL used by many endpoints; no exact precedent, mitigated by one shared filter and a live-Postgres reopen scenario test.
11 files (8 modified, 3 new) across docs, source and tests; roughly 1133 insertions, most of them tests.
